items.title: Josh Downs: Limited to one catch Thursday
items.body_text: Downs secured one of four targets for 13 yards in the Chiefs' 13-10 loss to the Bills on Thursday. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: DJ Moore: Pair of grabs in Week 12 win
items.body_text: Moore hauled in two of six targets for 15 yards in the Bills' 13-10 win over the Chiefs on Thursday. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Dalton Kincaid: Two catches in return
items.body_text: Kincaid brought in both targets for 13 yards in the Bills' 13-10 loss to the Chiefs on Thursday. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Rashee Rice: Forgettable numbers in loss
items.body_text: Rice brought in two of five targets for 19 yards in the Chiefs' 13-10 loss to the Bills on Thursday. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Patrick Mahomes: Unremarkable numbers in loss
items.body_text: Mahomes completed 16 of 29 passes for 174 yards with no touchdowns or interceptions and rushed three times for two yards in the Chiefs' 13-10 loss to the Bills on Thursday. He also fumbled twice but recovered on each occasion. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
